Follows Claude Code 2.1.328: desk-look now knows which system it runs on (`$.session.machine`), so opening a preview in the browser and `/desk-monitor` behave right off Linux, and copying a resume command from `/desk-sessions` works outside Wayland.

- **Open in browser**: desk-look asks Claude Code which system it runs on (`$.session.machine`, new in 2.1.328) and runs only the opener for it. Before, a Linux machine without `xdg-open` fell through to `open`, which on Linux is `openvt` and fails with an unrelated console error; now the toast says `xdg-open` couldn't start. On macOS it no longer fails a first `xdg-open` attempt before opening
- **`/desk-monitor` off Linux**: the pane measures from `/proc`, so on macOS it said "No running Claude session found" and kept reading every 2 seconds. It now says it works on Linux only and reads nothing
- **Copy the resume command**: when `/desk-sessions` can't move this window to a session in another folder, it copies `cd <folder> && claude --resume <id>` the way Claude Code's `/copy` does (the clipboard tool, or OSC 52 inside tmux or over SSH) instead of running `wl-copy`, which worked only on Wayland. desk-look no longer runs `wl-copy`
- desk-asana, desk-slack, desk-plan and desk-review move to 0.81.6 with only the version range raised

Needs Claude Code 2.1.328 or later.

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
